name: YSDAO staking permissionless sync
summary: The YSDAO staking contract's sync() has no access control and pushes the staking contract's entire USDT balance into the YSDAO/USDT pair before calling pair.sync(), which the attacker combined with the token's balance-versus-reserve add/remove-liquidity heuristics to bypass tax and extract the staked USDT.
